# Image Converter

Image Converter is a browser-based tool for converting images between PNG, JPEG, and WebP.

Canonical URL: https://convert.imageprivacy.org/

## Features

- Convert images to WebP, JPEG, or PNG
- Choose quality for compressed formats
- Set a background color for JPEG exports
- Process images locally in the browser

## Privacy model

The selected image is converted using browser canvas. Exporting creates a new metadata-light copy.
